eps.ov: The leader of the criminal esper organization P.A.N.D.R.A is imprisoned in the jail for espers, Deadlock. There he meets a man with unusually colored eyes who catches his interest, Andy Hinomiya.

eps.t: The Melody of Assassination -Ghost of WW2-
eps.ov: As Andy begins to familiarize himself within P.A.N.D.R.A, he is given his first mission to assassinate a mafia leader.

eps.t: Cleanliness and Pollution -Queen not a Princess-
eps.ov: P.A.N.D.R.A has kidnapped Princess Sophie a Pro-Esper activist. The plan to do so was formulated by non-other than Yugiri.
Hyobu Kyosuke has ordered the Catastrophe back to Japan where they at met with a warm welcome from old friends.
The crew enjoys some free time shopping. Andy treats Yugiri to a special treat but its cut short when he is visited by B.A.B.E.L with some important information.

eps.t: Darkness, Run -As true as a lie-
eps.ov: Not only is the secret of the Catastrophe is revealed but so has Andy’s hidden agenda. Does he have the power to stand against the Major?

eps.t: ESP Unit Part One -Generation ZERO PART I-
eps.ov: After his father’s death, Baron Tsubomi took in Kyosuke and raised him with his daughter Fujuko, a sensory user. Together with other sensory users they help form Japans first Special ESP Unit.

eps.t: ESP Unit Part Two -Generation ZERO PART II-
eps.ov: Kyosuke has been chosen to represent the E.S.P unit in the Navy war games. The Units future is on his shoulders.
The American government has made their move with a full on assault against the Catastrophe, but their real intentions are unknown even to their spy; History will repeat itself.

Old foes thought long gone, have been exposed as the mastermind behind the plans to sink the Catastrophe is taking Yugiri. This new information re-ignites the fire in Kyosuke as he shakes off death to get his revenge.
New York has a new Mayor that is in support of esper relationships, at the same time Hyobu and Andy work their way into the USEI facility only to discover…
Saotome plan is finally coming to fruition and with no one powerful enough to stop it, the world will be saved from Hyobu Kyoskue.
